title: CodeJudgeBench: Benchmarking LLM-as-a-Judge for Coding Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the presentation order (Position A vs. Position B) of the correct and incorrect candidate responses in pair-wise evaluation to measure discrepancies in the model's accuracy and identify tendencies like recency bias.

Evaluating the LLM-as-a-Judge models on candidate responses generated by different coding models (e.g., Gemini vs. Claude) to determine if judgments are improperly influenced by superficial coding styles or formatting rather than objective correctness.
